import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int N_MAX = 10;

    static class ModInt {
        int val;

        ModInt(long v) {
            v %= MOD;
            if (v < 0) v += MOD;
            this.val = (int) v;
        }

        static int modInverse(int a, int m) {
            int g = m, r = a, x = 0, y = 1;
            while (r != 0) {
                int q = g / r;
                int temp = g % r;
                g = r;
                r = temp;
                int tempX = x - q * y;
                x = y;
                y = tempX;
            }
            return x < 0 ? x + m : x;
        }

        ModInt add(ModInt other) {
            int res = this.val + other.val;
            if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }

        ModInt subtract(ModInt other) {
            int res = this.val - other.val;
            if (res < 0) res += MOD;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }

        ModInt multiply(ModInt other) {
            long res = (long) this.val * other.val % MOD;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }

        ModInt divide(ModInt other) {
            return this.multiply(new ModInt(modInverse(other.val, MOD)));
        }

        ModInt pow(long p) {
            ModInt result = new ModInt(1);
            ModInt base = new ModInt(this.val);
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) {
                    result = result.multiply(base);
                }
                base = base.multiply(base);
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        int intValue() {
            return this.val;
        }
    }

    static class SafeHash implements Comparator<Long>, Serializable {
        public int compare(Long a, Long b) { return 0; }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        int N = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        ModInt[][] probability = new ModInt[N][N];

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                int p = Integer.parseInt(parts[j]);
                probability[i][j] = new ModInt(p).divide(new ModInt(100));
            }
        }

        List<List<Integer>> masksWithCount = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
            masksWithCount.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }

        int[] lookup = new int[1 << N];
        Arrays.fill(lookup, -1);

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); mask++) {
            int count = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            lookup[mask] = masksWithCount.get(count).size();
            masksWithCount.get(count).add(mask);
        }

        Map<Long, ModInt> possibleMasks = new HashMap<>();
        possibleMasks.put(1L << lookup[0], new ModInt(1));

        for (int left = 0; left < N; left++) {
            Map<Long, ModInt> newPossibleMasks = new HashMap<>();
            ModInt[] products = new ModInt[1 << N];
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << N); i++) {
                products[i] = new ModInt(1);
            }

            for (int current = 0; current < (1 << N); current++) {
                for (int right = 0; right < N; right++) {
                    ModInt term = ( ( (current >> right) & 1) == 1) ? probability[left][right] : new ModInt(1).subtract(probability[left][right]);
                    products[current] = products[current].multiply(term);
                }
            }

            for (Map.Entry<Long, ModInt> p : possibleMasks.entrySet()) {
                long possible = p.getKey();
                ModInt prob = p.getValue();

                long[] newBits = new long[N];
                Arrays.fill(newBits, 0L);
                long[] newPossibleArray = new long[1 << N];
                Arrays.fill(newPossibleArray, 0L);
                for (int mask : masksWithCount.get(left)) {
                    if (((possible >> lookup[mask]) & 1) != 0) {
                        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                            if (((mask >> i) & 1) == 0) {
                                long newMaskBit = 1L << lookup[mask | (1 << i)];
                                newBits[i] |= newMaskBit;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                newPossibleArray[0] = 0L;

                for (int current = 1; current < (1 << N); current++) {
                    int shift = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(current);
                    long previous = current & (current - 1);
                    newPossibleArray[current] = newPossibleArray[(int) previous] | newBits[shift];
                    ModInt valueToAdd = prob.multiply(products[current]);
                    long key = newPossibleArray[current];
                    newPossibleMasks.put(key, newPossibleMasks.getOrDefault(key, new ModInt(0)).add(valueToAdd));
                }
            }

            possibleMasks = newPossibleMasks;
        }

        int maskAll = (1 << N) - 1;
        long targetBit = 1L << lookup[maskAll];

        ModInt answer = new ModInt(0);
        for (Map.Entry<Long, ModInt> p : possibleMasks.entrySet()) {
            if (((p.getKey() & targetBit) != 0)) {
                answer = answer.add(p.getValue());
            }
        }

        System.out.println(answer.intValue());
    }
}
